QuestInfo.name: Medicine Money
QuestInfo.0: #b#p438##k is ready to explain why she steals from the Hollow.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p438##k's partner #bPerry#k is sick. His skin is turning purple, and there's no one to treat him. It looks like the rot from the Hollow. I should ask #b#p712##k in #b#m010006160##k.
QuestInfo.2: I told #b#p712##k about #bPerry#k. He believes it is the rot, but there may still be time.

0.0: My partner #bPerry#k found the way into the Hollow first. He only went at night, through the Forgotten Entrance, and he never went near the fairies' village.
0.1: He wanted to see the deep tunnels, where even the fairies don't go anymore. A month ago he came back sick. First his hands went purple, then his arms.
0.2: Nobody in Kerning City treats thieves, so I hid him somewhere safe. I'm the only one who knows where.
0.3: Medicine costs money, so I sell what I find in the Hollow. I know it's wrong. I just didn't know what else to do.
0.4: The purple looks just like the rot on the trees down there. ...You know someone in the Hollow who studies it? Would you ask him about #bPerry#k?

yes.0: #b#p712##k, in #b#m010006160##k... Please hurry. If there's anything that can help him, I'll give back everything I took.

no.0: I get it. Why would anyone help a thief?

1.0: A young human with purple skin? Tell me everything. Leave nothing out.
1.1: ...Purple from the hands up, and spreading slowly. Yes. That is the rot. It must have touched him in the deep tunnels. No fairy has walked there in years. No wonder no one saw him.
1.2: Do not lose hope. The rot moves slowly in people. There may still be time.
